details:
- Rebuild against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to pick up the Go
  standard library fixes for:
- CVE-2026-33818: enforce a maximum recursion depth in encoding/asn1 Unmarshal
  to prevent stack exhaustion when parsing deeply-nested recursive structures
- CVE-2026-56853: apply ReadHeaderTimeout to the server's unencrypted HTTP/2
  client preface check, and clear the connection timeouts again once the
  connection is handed off to the http2 package
- CVE-2026-56858: fix JavaScript regexp context tracking in html/template so
  that pathological input can no longer close an unescaped '/' early and
  inject attacker-controlled content
- CVE-2026-56860: avoid quadratic complexity in net/url resolvePath by
  resolving '..' segments with index-based backtracking on a byte buffer
- CVE-2026-56862: do not count handshake messages as state-advancing after the
  handshake has completed in crypto/tls, bounding the key derivation work a
  client can force with repeated KeyUpdate messages
